lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੩ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ghar 3 mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third House, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh lasakar lakh vaaje neje lakh uth karahi salaam ||
lines.translation: You may have thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and lances, and thousands of men to rise and salute you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakhaa upar phuramaais teree lakh uth raakhahi maan ||
lines.translation: Your rule may extend over thousands of miles, and thousands of men may rise to honor you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) sabh niraaphal kaam ||1||
lines.translation: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of your ostentatious show is useless. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke naam binaa jag dha(n)dhaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the world is in turmoil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੋਲਾ ਭੀ ਸੋ ਅੰਧੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: je bahutaa samajhaaeeai bholaa bhee so a(n)dho a(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Even though the fool may be taught again and again, he remains the blindest of the blind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ ਲਖ ਸੰਜੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਜਹਿ ਲਖ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh khateeahi lakh sa(n)jeeahi khaajahi lakh aavahi lakh jaahi ||
lines.translation: You may earn thousands, collect thousands, and spend thousands of dollars; thousands may come, and thousands may go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਕਿਥੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) jee kithai phir paahi ||2||
lines.translation: But, if your honor is of no account to the Lord, then where will you go to find a safe haven? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ਲਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh saasat samajhaavanee lakh pa(n)dit paRahi puraan ||
lines.translation: Thousands of Shaastras may be explained to the mortal, and thousands of Pandits may read the Puraanas to him;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੇ ਕੁਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) pat lekhai naa pavai taa(n) sabhe kuparavaan ||3||
lines.translation: but, if his honor is of no account to the Lord, then all of this is unacceptable. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach naam pat oopajai karam naam karataar ||
lines.translation: Honor comes from the True Name, the Name of the Merciful Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis hiradai je vasai naanak nadaree paar ||4||1||31||
lines.translation: If it abides in the heart, day and night, O Nanak, then the mortal shall swim across, by His Grace. ||4||1||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਵਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: deevaa meraa ek naam dukh vich paaiaa tel ||
lines.translation: The One Name is my lamp; I have put the oil of suffering into it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨਿ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: un chaanan ohu sokhiaa chookaa jam siu mel ||1||
lines.translation: Its flame has dried up this oil, and I have escaped my meeting with the Messenger of Death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਫਕੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lokaa mat ko phakaR paai ||
lines.translation: O people, do not make fun of me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਮੜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਏਕਠੇ ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਲੇ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh maRiaa kar ekathe ek ratee le bhaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Thousands of wooden logs, piled up together, need only a tiny flame to burn. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੇਸਉ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pi(n)d patal meree kesau kiriaa sach naam karataar ||
lines.translation: The Lord is my festive dish, of rice balls on leafy plates; the True Name of the Creator Lord is my funeral ceremony.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aithai othai aagai paachhai ehu meraa aadhaar ||2||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, in the past and in the future, this is my support. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਨਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ga(n)g banaaras siphat tumaaree naavai aatam raau ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Praise is my River Ganges and my city of Benares; my soul takes its sacred cleansing bath there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa naavan taa(n) theeai jaa(n) ahinis laagai bhaau ||3||
lines.translation: That becomes my true cleansing bath, if night and day, I enshrine love for You. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਲੋਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਛਮਿਛਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਵਟਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik lokee hor chhamichharee braahaman vat pi(n)d khaai ||
lines.translation: The rice balls are offered to the gods and the dead ancestors, but it is the Brahmins who eat them!

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਕਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨਿਖੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pi(n)d bakhasees kaa kabahoo(n) nikhootas naahi ||4||2||32||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the rice balls of the Lord are a gift which is never exhausted. ||4||2||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa ghar 4 mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth House, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: devatiaa darasan kai taaee dookh bhookh teerath keee ||
lines.translation: The Gods, yearning for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, suffered through pain and hunger at the sacred shrines.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਵੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee jugat mahi rahate kar kar bhagave bhekh bhae ||1||
lines.translation: The yogis and the celibates live their disciplined lifestyle, while others wear saffron robes and become hermits. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau kaaran saahibaa ra(n)g rate ||
lines.translation: For Your sake, O Lord Master, they are imbued with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere naam anekaa roop ana(n)taa kahan na jaahee tere gun kete ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your Names are so many, and Your Forms are endless. No one can tell how may Glorious Virtues You have. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਲਾਇਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਗਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar ghar mahalaa hasatee ghoRe chhod vilaait des gae ||
lines.translation: Leaving behind hearth and home, palaces, elephants, horses and native lands, mortals have journeyed to foreign lands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪੇਕਾਂਬਰ ਸਾਲਿਕ ਸਾਦਿਕ ਛੋਡੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: peer pekaa(n)bar saalik saadik chhodee duneeaa thaai pae ||2||
lines.translation: The spiritual leaders, prophets, seers and men of faith renounced the world, and became acceptable. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ ਕਾਪੜ ਛੋਡੇ ਚਮੜ ਲੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: saad sahaj sukh ras kas tajeeale kaapaR chhode chamaR leee ||
lines.translation: Renouncing tasty delicacies, comfort, happiness and pleasures, some have abandoned their clothes and now wear skins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦਰਦਵੰਦ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dukheee daradava(n)d dar terai naam rate daraves bhae ||3||
lines.translation: Those who suffer in pain, imbued with Your Name, have become beggars at Your Door. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਲੜੀ ਖਪਰੀ ਲਕੜੀ ਚਮੜੀ ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khalaRee khaparee lakaRee chamaRee sikhaa soot dhotee keenhee ||
lines.translation: Some wear skins, and carry begging bowls, bearing wooden staffs, and sitting on deer skins. Others raise their hair in tufts and wear sacred threads and loin-cloths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹਉ ਸਾਂਗੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) saahib hau saa(n)gee teraa pranavai naanak jaat kaisee ||4||1||33||
lines.translation: You are the Lord Master, I am just Your puppet. Prays Nanak, what is my social status to be? ||4||1||33||
